title: This is just what Heaven means to me
lyrics: Verse 1:
[C]A country where no [F]twilight shadows [C]deepen
Unending day where night will never [G]be
A [C]city where no [F]storm clouds ever [C]gather
This is just what [G]Heaven means to [C]m [F]- [C]e
Verse 2:
[C]It's a place where there [F]is no misunder - [C]standing
And from all enmity and strife we're [G]free
No [C]unkind words to [F]wound our hearts are [C]spoken
This is just what [G]Heaven means to [C]m [F]- [C]e
Chorus 1:
[C]What will it be when [F]we get over [C]yonder
And join the throng upon the glass - [G]y sea
We'll [C]join our loved ones [F]and crown Christ [C]forever
This is just what [G]Heaven means to [C]m [F]- [C]e
Verse 3:
[C]And then at last I'll [F]see the face of [C] Jesus
And before whose image other loves all [G]flee
Ah, but [C]when they crown Him [F]Lord of All [C]I'll be there
This is just what [G]Heaven means to [C]m [F]- [C]e
Chorus 2:
[C]What will it be when [F]we get over [C]yonder
And we'll join the throng upon the glass - [G]y sea
We'll [C]join our loved ones [F]and crown Christ [C]forever
This is just what [G]Heaven means to [C]m [F]- [C]e
